entries.en:
The Gundu's stockpiles of food grow scarcer by the day, while the Vundu larders swell to bursting with supplies. As his people come to terms with the imminent threat of starvation, he bids you slink into the Vundu camp and steal away with four of their pots of food.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

entries.en: Ecstatic that his tribe is no longer faced with the grim threat of starvation, Muna Vanu explains the reasons for their lack of food and the Vundu's abundance of it. Now that the Gundu have been forced from the verdant land they once called home, they have nowhere to catch food, while the Vundu hunt and gather at their leisure. With only so much food to go around, and all of it in Vundu larders, the Gundu may have to help themselves to their enemy's supplies for the time being.
entries.fr: Lorsque vous lui avez apporté les jarres, Muna Vanu vous a expliqué que les terres abondantes sur lesquelles les Vundu se procuraient de la nourriture étaient encore il y a peu celles des Gundu, jusqu'à ce qu'elles leur soient arrachées par les Vanu Vanu malfaisants. Même s'il espère que son peuple sera un jour en mesure de reprendre son dû, il n'a pas d'autre choix que de compter sur votre aide en attendant.
entries.ja: ムナバヌに「」を渡した。荷籠の中身は、リーチの干物だったようだ。これを狩った狩場は元々グンドの土地であったため、ムナバヌは備蓄状況を予想できたという。彼は定期的に狩場の使用料をいただくつもりらしいので、そのときはまた協力しよう。

entries.en: Gundu food supplies dwindle. But Ok' Vundu stocks grow fat like their wives. Surely Vundu not notice some few missing pots. Please gather food for us from their larders. Without them, Gundu may not survive next season.
entries.fr: Les réserves de nourriture de notre tribu sont aussi maigres qu'un dhalmel au régime, alors que celles des Vundu grossissent à vue d'œil. C'est injuste ! Il faut vite que tu arranges ça.

今の時期なら、奴らは食料を溜め込んでいるはずですからな。
